text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Alert 2061234567 — Elevated 5xx rate detected for /v1/generate in us-west-2 (rate 4.8% over baseline). Trigger: prefix-cache error spikes and gateway timeouts.

oncall-amber: I’m on pager. can folks post initial impact? which customers/paths?

sam.dev: seeing ~20% request failures for routes with prefix cache enabled, errors look like 502 and 504 from gateway and 5xx from prefix-cache shards.

lila-sre: Metrics: eviction_rate on prefix-cache-pool spiked x100 at 11:05 UTC, miss ratio jumped, p99 latency on cache ops -> 450ms. Correlation with config rollout 11:00 that bumped prefetch window.

raj-eng: copying logs — sample stack: `ERR kv-prefix-store: failed fetch, status=5xx, cause=corruption` repeating. Also a lot of `oom` messages on cache pods in logs around 11:04.

josh-support: CS reported 3 customers seeing failed inference for multi-turn chat (timeout + 5xx). sending list to @customer-ops.

customer-ops: Received from AcmeCorp, NeonHealth — they see intermittent failures and reduced throughput. Impact: their frontends mark request failed and retry, causing increased load.

oncall-amber: OK immediate plan: 1) mitigate customer impact by routing traffic away from prefix-cache for high latency routes (feature-flag). 2) reduce eviction churn (temp config revert). 3) rollback prefetch change if safe. Assign tasks: sam — open FF to bypass prefix cache; lila — scale cache nodes + look at pod oom; raj — prepare patch to accept-stale fallback; josh — notify customers.

sam.dev: filed flag: `ff.bypass_prefix_cache=on` for cluster us-west-2, rolling ramp 10%. command: `rb config set ff.bypass_prefix_cache true --cluster us-west-2 --rate 0.1`

lila-sre: scaling prefix-cache statefulset +2 replicas. `kubectl -n inference scale sts prefix-cache-pool --replicas=6` — watch logs for stability.

raj-eng: quick patch to fallback code: accept stale if kv error code >=500 for 30s. building a hotfix; will push to canary. also preparing script to flush suspected corrupted key ranges.

sam.dev: traffic ramp to 50% bypass pushed. frontend routes should hit cold path now. Monitoring: errors dropping to 1.9% after initial ramp.

lila-sre: noticed one cache pod OOM loop with repeated GC; deployed memory bump to that pod's spec and restarted. logs show prefix index corruption stacktrace before OOM: `panic: invalid prefix entry length`. suspect corruption leading to eviction spiral.

josh-support: Customer update sent: "We're investigating elevated errors; temporary routing change to reduce failures. We'll update in 30 mins or earlier."

oncall-amber: good. raj — how long for patch? canary results?

raj-eng: canary applied to worker-7, observed successful accept-stale behavior, no increased tail latency for requests served stale; errors for that canary fell to 0.8%. prepping prod rollout in 10min.

lila-sre: manual scan shows ~0.02% keyspace with inconsistent checksums across replicas. patch will keep stale and queue async repair; won't block reads.

sam.dev: rolling 100% bypass now. errors down to 0.6%. p99 latency increased mildly on hot paths but service is functional.

oncall-amber: customer impact assessment: 12 customers had increased errors; 3 had significant P50 regressions. CS already flagged top 3 for remediation credits as needed.

josh-support: Confirmed notifications sent to affected customers with mitigation steps and ETA for full fix.

lila-sre: next actions: 1) run targeted re-encode of corrupted key ranges during maintenance window. 2) revert prefetch window change in config to prevent future eviction storms. 3) add checksum validation and repair job to autoservice.

raj-eng: will push hotfix for accept-stale to all regions and a small repair job. patch link: https://git.internal/r/kv-prefix/accept-stale-hotfix (internal).

oncall-amber: escalation? do we need infra or on-call backups?

lila-sre: request infra to check underlying node memory/IO — possible hardware issue causing corruption. @infra-team please hop in.

incident-bot: Incident 2061234567 set to "investigating". Pager duty: Amber -> next handoff at 2026-03-16 07:00 UTC.

sam.dev: quick postmortem notes: root cause likely prefetch config change + memory pressure causing key corruption -> eviction storm -> increased misses -> 5xx. Short term mitigations: bypass prefix cache, accept-stale fallback, scale + restart oom pods.

josh-support: Are we OK to hand off to morning team after final checks? I can stay on for 15 more minutes to ensure customer comms.

oncall-amber: yes, plan to handoff at 11:45 UTC. final state: bypass flag on, hotfix rolling in, replication repair job queued, rc pods stable. Last error rate 0.4%.

lila-sre: also added alarm for checksum drift and eviction_rate > 10x baseline to prevent silent recurrence.

raj-eng: afterhand tasks assigned: 1) full repair job during low traffic 03:00 UTC. 2) revert prefetch config in config-store. 3) add unit/integration tests for prefix decode length.

josh-support: Thanks team. I'll update the incident doc and prewrite customer follow-ups.

oncall-amber: handing off to morning oncall @oncall-miguel — please review state and continue runbook. :thumbsup:

incident-bot: Incident 2061234567 updated — state: monitoring. Postmortem owner: raj-eng. Runbook link: https://incidents.redwood/in/2061234567 (internal).
